topic: Which parts of AGENTS.md no longer describe reality, and which explain in detail what a delegate already owns? Keep the two failure classes strictly apart and cite file:line for every claim. Class one, not reality. Class two, redundant detail. Known confirmed instance of class one: checklist.md. Three-way discrimination test governs every class-two finding: case one reduces to a pointer and quotes the delegate's own line; case two binds when no delegate loads; case three is prompt-time discipline.
